scope: Portable editorial/state/camera/ending training from owner-requested review of a delivered film. Raw media, prompts, transcript, per-frame reports and provider receipts stay local.
demonstrated_failure_classes: invented or duplicated cast and roles
missing causal performance and revelation order
plot-critical text failures and possible staging-speech leakage
isolated repairs incompatible with neighboring setup
saved_operational_fixes: existing beat map owns audience knowledge, causal outcomes and ending
current compatible state references, distinct cast and scale/geography anchors
camera placement and purpose, action phase and entry/exit contract
actual source selection instead of automatic full-container timeline
native mouth timing, exact dialogue separated from staging, meaningful sound tails
repair within established neighboring world; reconcile affected coverage
approximate runtime flexes; main resolution completed before optional stinger
one existing brief moving-output check; no new recurring paid/per-clip audit
limits: Training instructions and source-routing validation do not prove improved generated footage.
Receiving-device hardware/provider behavior and owner acceptance of a future film remain unverified.
The preserved reviewed film was not regenerated by this training task.
